by
  intro 𝕜 _ E F _ _ _ _ T M x hM hb hx ht
  apply le_antisymm (T.opNorm_le_bound hM hb)
  refine le_of_tendsto' ht fun n => ?_

  rwa [hx n, mul_one] at h
